steps.title: Analyze Build Failures
steps.description: Inspect the build logs to locate resource linking and syntax issues in activity_main.xml and MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Fix activity_main.xml width layout error
steps.description: Replace the invalid attribute value 'match_match' with 'match_parent' in activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Fix activity_main.xml centering attributes
steps.description: Correct layout_centerY with layout_centerVertical in relative layout children within activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Correct syntax error in MainActivity.java
steps.description: Resolve the '12spToPx' typo on the text size setting call inside MainActivity.java to ensure successful compilation.

steps.title: Validate layout alignment and padding
steps.description: Review layout margins, weights, padding, and alignments to ensure no other AAPT issues persist.

steps.title: Verify resource references
steps.description: Ensure layout file references align with drawables and color resources without broken IDs.

steps.title: Verify Java imports
steps.description: Ensure MainActivity.java uses correct class imports and standard Android system components.

steps.title: Check Manifest registrations
steps.description: Ensure AndroidManifest.xml uses the proper package namespace com.notesmanager.app and lists MainActivity.

steps.title: Clean Build cache and assets
steps.description: Perform verification step to prepare for clean compiling after layout changes.

steps.title: Building Notes Manager
steps.description: Launch compilation to generate a successful build of Notes Manager with target requirements.
